# [STORY] As a project owner, I want a scaffolded multi-module Gradle project with CI templates and local infra, so that development starts on a consistent foundation

## User Story
**As a** project owner
**I want** a scaffolded multi-module Gradle project with CI templates and local infrastructure
**So that** development starts on a consistent foundation

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a clone of this repository, when `./gradlew build` runs, then all
      9 backend modules build from one root configuration
      (Backend CI step `./gradlew clean build -x test`)
- [x] Given a clone, when the scaffolding is inspected, then every backend
      module, the frontend, `infrastructure/` and `docs/` exist in their
      expected places
      (`ProjectStructureTest.scaffoldedDirectoriesExist`,
      `ProjectStructureTest.everyBackendModuleHasAReadme`)
- [x] Given a push to main or develop, when it touches backend or frontend
      code, then the matching CI workflow runs
      (`ProjectStructureTest.continuousIntegrationWorkflowsTriggerOnPush`)
- [x] Given a new issue, when it is opened, then the four issue templates and
      the pull request template are available
      (`ProjectStructureTest.issueAndPullRequestTemplatesExist`)
- [x] Given `docker compose up`, when the stack starts, then PostgreSQL,
      MongoDB and Redis come up with healthchecks and named volumes
      (`ProjectStructureTest.composeDefinesThreeDatabasesWithHealthchecksAndNamedVolumes`)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)
